about: The Peruque Creek watershed covers about 61 square miles of St. Charles County. It is made up of 2 smaller watersheds: Headwaters Peruque Creek and Peruque Creek. Click one to open it. The land ranges from about 810 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 430 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Peruque Creek and Sams Creek. Communities here include Wentzville, Lake St. Louis, O'Fallon, St. Paul, Josephville and Foristell. All of its water ends up in the Mississippi River.
